relationship.original_equation: Z = 1.2 × working capital/assets + 1.4 × retained earnings/assets + 3.3 × EBIT/assets + 0.6 × market equity/book liabilities + sales/assets
relationship.locator: Printed p8, Table 1; printed p10, original score zones
relationship.translation_notes: Inputs and output are dimensionless; ratios may be negative when the underlying financial amounts are negative.

assumptions: Input ratios follow the original model definitions, including market equity and book total liabilities.
Total assets and book total liabilities used to calculate the inputs are nonzero and consistently measured.
limitations: Originally estimated on a small historical sample of publicly listed US manufacturing companies; applicability and calibration in other settings require separate validation.
The score is not a probability of default and a classification threshold is not a guarantee.
Other Altman variants use different coefficients or definitions; the 1.0 sales weight follows the rounded presentation in the assigned PDF.
